title: Epic edge proposal
description: The edge file the epic-dependency-assessor writes for ONE Epic in the dependency-assessment workflow: the candidate <workDir>/candidates/edges.json, which jsonartifact.py validates against this file and publishes as <workDir>/edges.json. `depscore.py validate` then checks it against the tracker and `depscore.py apply-edges` applies it as beads `tracks` edges. Nothing of it is recorded in the matrix. The session runs no `put`, no `link` and no apply. The rule that draws an edge is the agent-teams-workforce:epic-sequencing skill's. The owner runs this workflow; the order of every Epic is computed by scripts/portfolio/epicorder.py, whose --apply replaces the owned edges this file sets.

edges.description: EVERY edge to or from the assessed Epic that the rule draws, each owned standing edge it keeps included, and no edge that does not touch it.

withdrawn.description: Every owned standing edge (the context's `standing` with `owned: true`) that `edges` does not keep. An edge with `owned: false` is in neither list.

Edge.description: One Epic-to-Epic edge: a shared item both Epics need (a feature serving their requirements, or an architecture entry they reach by the rule of reach) has architecture that is not approved, and the matrix records `from` as the Epic that goes first on it (a `drives` judgment from `from` to the item, or the owner's decision for the item's stack). `from` is elaborated before `to`; both are Epics.

from.description: The beads id of the Epic that goes first on the item.

to.description: The beads id of the other Epic that needs the item.

reason.description: The item, the Epic that goes first, the basis and the recorded reason, in one line.

archCheck.description: The id of the shared item that makes this edge, its recorded decision (a judgment on the item, or the owner's decision for its stack), and that its architecture is not approved (for a feature: a realizer without the `approved` mark, or no realizer). Only the `approved` mark removes the edge: an entry existing or a document at `lifecycle: effective` does not. An edge without it is refused.

answers.description: Required only on an edge the context's `withdrawn` list covers: why the recorded withdrawal reason is wrong, on the architecture. Without it that edge is refused.
